messages:
Alex: Heads up — noticed a weird bump in chargeback counts for the EU route this morning. invoice-preview shows ~1.8x tokens for a handful of tenants.
Mira: Ugh. Is that the route-tag duplication we saw last month or something new?
Alex: Not the same pattern. Traced back to the stateless proxy when it retried on a backend 503. Two different route headers got attached before dedupe ran.
Sanjay: Can you paste the exact headers? if we can reproduce we can fix at proxy level.
Alex: Sure — snippet from request capture:
```
GET /v1/generate
x-tenant: tenant-42
x-route: eu-primary
x-route-fallback: eu-secondary
x-route: eu-primary
```
Beth: oh wow, duplicate x-route entries. Our metering pipeline keys off the first route header but our routing-service stamps a route tag later which the ledger also picks up. so both landed.
Will: That explains why invoice-preview and realtime-dashboard disagree — preview de-dupes differently during aggregation stages.
Mira: Short-term: can we make the metering pre-processor collapse duplicate route fields and prefer the earliest one? low-risk change.
Sanjay: We can, but need to be careful: some tenants intentionally send multiple route hints for affinity tests. maybe add a fold that collapses identical values only.
Alex: For immediate relief i've added a temporary filter in the proxy to drop subsequent x-route headers if a duplicate value already exists.
ops-bot: deploy success — proxy filter rolled to eu-edge-canary (rev: proxy-6f3b).
Beth: Next steps: create a unit test in metering that simulates duplicate headers and verifies single attribution, and a dashboard alert for sudden route-tag entropy spikes.
Will: I'll own the alert. Should trigger if >5% of requests have >1 route tag within 10m window.
Mira: And i'll open a changelist to normalize route stamp ordering in routing-service so we don't rely on header order.
Alex: Thanks — let's monitor invoice preview for the next 6 hours and then plan a small backfill run if needed.
Sanjay: leaving a note: if backfill runs, ensure idempotent ledger writes or we'll re-create the same duplicate lines.
Beth: Adding a metadata flag to mark backfill window so billing-ui can suppress transient deltas.
Alex: :thumbsup: closing for now, will ping if counts don't stabilize.
